items.text:
This is a very very cool game, it needs more content, its systems need a little more fleshing out but i have quite a lot of faith in the dev and blue bottle games, neo scavenger has a really special place in my heart and i feel like ostranauts will as well.

it was quite a long time ago, i cant remember exactly but closer to 15 then 10 years i think, late one night i bought an alpha of neo scavenger, off of dbgames no less! booted it up and started a game, within 10 mins of character generation i beat a man to death with a shoe and robbed his corpse and in that moment i knew i had found something special.

 I really cant wait for ship to ship combat, theres alot of little issues and sticking points but its well on its way to being one of the most unique space games out there and honestly something like this should have come along before now but its quite a good thing that blue bottle is the one doing it.

the devs do need to widen some of the things like who you can sell to without a scrap liscense or maybe add a few different places like the flotilla, give the player a little more agency, also maybe give us a system that allows us to queue up actions, there is one but its more for using during travel, its not something you can use when say scrapping a ship as i can spend 2 hours doing so but its draining, i feel like im working data entry or some such soul grinding labor, i get there should be a hint of that but just a hint.

AI needs some work but i can imagine you could say that for any game and i imagine its not an easy thing to do at all.

it takes a bit to get the hang of and i would watch a few videos before buying and when learning it, just dont give up on it, once the systems click its quite great.

If you think you will like it, you probably will, buy it and enjoy!!

P.S. I actually bounced off this game once before and requested a refund but it almost infected me, i couldnt stop thinking about it and like a week later rebought it and havent looked back.
items.text_zh:
这是一款非常非常酷的游戏，它需要更多内容，它的系统需要再完善一些，但我对开发者和Blue Bottle Games相当有信心，Neo Scavenger在我心中有着非常特殊的位置，我觉得Ostranauts也会如此。

那是很久以前了，我记不太清具体时间，但我觉得更接近15年而不是10年，某天深夜我买了一份Neo Scavenger的alpha版，还是在dbgames上买的！启动它并开始了一局游戏，在角色创建后10分钟内，我就用一只鞋把一个人打死了，还洗劫了他的尸体，那一刻我就知道我找到了某种特别的东西。

我真的等不及舰对舰战斗了，有很多小问题和卡点，但它正稳步成为市面上最独特的太空游戏之一，说实话这样的东西早就该出现了，但由Blue Bottle来做这件事是件相当好的事。

开发者确实需要放宽一些东西，比如在没有废料许可证的情况下你能卖给谁，或者也许增加几个不同的地方，比如flotilla，给玩家多一点自主权，另外也许给我们一个能排队安排行动的系统，有一个，但它更多是用于旅行期间，比如拆解一艘船时你就用不了，因为我可以花2个小时做这件事，但那很累人，我感觉自己像是在做数据录入或某种磨人的苦力活，我明白应该有那么一点这种感觉，但只是一点点就好。

AI需要一些改进，但我想任何游戏你都可以这么说，而且我想这根本不是件容易的事。

上手需要一点时间，我建议在购买前和学习它的时候看几个视频，就是别放弃它，一旦系统开窍了，它就相当棒。

如果你觉得你会喜欢它，那你很可能真的会，买下来享受吧！！

附言：其实我之前有一次放弃过这款游戏并申请了退款，但它几乎感染了我，我无法停止想它，大约一周后我又重新买了它，从此再没回头。
